# Every Row

## Intro x2
```
|: C | Am | F | G7 :| x2
C  G  Am  G
```

## Verse
```
C              Am
Paper boats go sailing
F            G7
down the gutter stream
C   F       G7     C
Everyone is waving home
Am7(11) D7
little lilies in a row
```

## Spoken
```
here the band stops and someone counts to four

C | F | G7 | C
```

Let the last chord ring until the room is quiet.

Then start again, a little slower.
